'''Shadevale stalkers''' were serpentine creatures native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. They were known to make their homes in the pools and streams of the [[Kkowir Forest/Legends|Kkowir Forest]]. They were similar in appearance to, and related to the [[Crystal snake/Legends|crystal snakes]] of [[Yavin 4]].

[[Shadevale stalker|Shadevale venomstings]] were another type of [[Snake/Legends|snake]] on Kashyyyk, yet they were more closely related to [[Fanned rawl|rawls]].
